description: Edezee evaluation set. Each case defines an input, the behaviour the system must show, and how to score it. Cases marked "mock": true use a scripted provider so results are reproducible without API keys.

rubric.topic_coverage: Every parsed topic produces exactly one slide, in order.
rubric.schema_compliance: Every slide has 1-5 bullets, a non-empty title, and speaker notes.
rubric.content_specificity: Every non-degraded slide has at least one bullet contributing three content words absent from its own title, so a slide cannot merely restate its topic. Placeholder wording on a non-degraded slide is scored separately as no_placeholder_leak. Generic phrasing (TBD, 'this topic') is recorded as the no_generic_wording signal, not a hard failure: a vague topic name legitimately produces abstract content.
rubric.notes_quality: Speaker notes exist, are at least 40 characters, and are not a copy of the bullets.
rubric.grounding_recorded: Every slide declares research | model-knowledge | placeholder.
rubric.graceful_degradation: Failures produce a flagged placeholder slide, never a crash or a silent drop.
rubric.latency: Every case declares a max_latency_ms budget scaled to its topic count. Live budgets assume ~15s per topic, which is the measured median for the configured model; TC-08 (40 topics) is allowed 900s.
